question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The engineers finally __destroyed__ the ship to its original form.
solution:
The correct answer is '**restored**'.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**destroyed**' is '**restored**'.
 
• **Destroyed**: to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
 
 
• *Example: The building was **destroyed** by fire.*
 
 
 
• **Restored**: to put somebody/something back into his/her/its former condition or position. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को उसकी पूर्व दशा या स्थिति में लाना)
 
 
• *Example: She **restores** old furniture as a hobby.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** restored.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **reversed**: to put something in the opposite position to normal or to how it was before. (पहले किए का उलटा या विपरीत करना)
 
• **started**: to begin doing something. (कुछ करना आरंभ करना)
 
• **abolished**: to end a law or system officially. (किसी क़ानून या प्रथा को आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्‍त करना)
